entry.description: count only the current date's backups when `RollingFileAppender` starts. A date pattern without separators (`.yyyyMMdd`) was read as a backup number, a date pattern supplying the extension with `PreserveLogFileNameExtension` lost the current date's backups on restart, and backups of earlier dates raised the current count. With a static file name, a date pattern that formats as a short number (`.dd`, `.MM`, `.HH`, `.yyyy`) names dated files exactly like numbered backups, so no numbered backups are made for it: size rolling is switched off, the existing file is appended to at start-up, and a `FATAL` line explains why. The new `IgnoreDateWarnings` property keeps the configured behaviour (fixed by @Snotface)
